audience: restaurants, cafes and venues that run orders through Tavzio point of sale

useCases.title: See which orders are still preparing
useCases.text: List the order records of the business, page by page. Open one order to read its status and total.

useCases.title: Check which resources this key can use
useCases.text: List the business resources with their read, write and delete flags and the scopes each one needs. The list is not filtered by the key, so a call can still return 403.

useCases.title: Read menu items and tables
useCases.text: List the menu or table records of the business, page by page. Read one record by its id.

useCases.title: Mark an order as ready
useCases.text: Move one order to pending, preparing, ready, completed or cancelled. The change follows the dashboard rules and can start kitchen or POS actions.
